sections.IT_43_title: Penalty & Compensation for Damage to Computer
sections.IT_43_desc: Applies when a person accesses or downloads data from a computer system without the owner's permission, or causes denial of service.
sections.IT_43_punish: Compensation up to ₹1 Crore payable to the affected person.
sections.IT_66_desc: Criminalises dishonest or fraudulent acts described under Section 43 — including hacking and data theft.
sections.IT_66_punish: Imprisonment up to 3 years and/or fine up to ₹5 Lakhs.
sections.IT_66B_desc: Applies when a person dishonestly receives or retains any stolen computer resource or communication device knowing it to be stolen.
sections.IT_66B_punish: Imprisonment up to 3 years and/or fine up to ₹1 Lakh.
sections.IT_66C_desc: Covers fraudulent or dishonest use of another person's electronic signature, password, or any other unique identification feature.
sections.IT_66C_punish: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to ₹1 Lakh.
sections.IT_66D_title: Cheating by Personation via Computer Resource
sections.IT_66D_desc: Applies when a person cheats another by impersonating them using a computer resource or communication device (e.g. phishing sites, fake profiles).
sections.IT_66D_punish: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine up to ₹1 Lakh.
sections.IT_66E_desc: Covers intentional capture, publication, or transmission of images of a person's private areas without consent.
sections.IT_66E_punish: Imprisonment up to 3 years and/or fine up to ₹2 Lakhs.
sections.IT_66F_desc: Applies when acts threaten the unity, integrity, security, or sovereignty of India via computer networks, or cause denial of access to authorised personnel.
sections.IT_66F_punish: Imprisonment which may extend to life.
sections.IT_67_title: Publishing Obscene Material in Electronic Form
sections.IT_67_desc: Covers publication or transmission of obscene material in electronic form.
sections.IT_67_punish: First conviction: up to 3 years and fine up to ₹5 Lakhs. Subsequent: up to 5 years and fine up to ₹10 Lakhs.
sections.IT_69_title: Power to Issue Directions for Interception / Monitoring / Decryption
sections.IT_69_desc: Authorises the Government to intercept, monitor, or decrypt information through any computer resource in the interest of national security. Relevant when encrypted communications (e.g. PGP keys) are discovered.
sections.IT_69_punish: Failure to comply: imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.
sections.IT_72_desc: Covers disclosure of information accessed during the course of powers granted under the IT Act without the consent of the person.
sections.IT_72_punish: Imprisonment up to 2 years and/or fine up to ₹1 Lakh.
sections.BNS_318_desc: Covers deceiving any person and fraudulently inducing them to deliver property or to do/omit to do any act (digital or physical). Applies to online fraud, fake listings, and crypto scams.
sections.BNS_318_punish: Imprisonment up to 3 years and/or fine.
sections.BNS_318_4_desc: Aggravated form of cheating causing delivery of property or inducing an act that leads to damage. Applies to large-scale online fraud and impersonation websites.
sections.BNS_318_4_punish: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.
sections.BNS_316_desc: Applies when a person entrusted with property or authority over it, dishonestly misappropriates it. Relevant in cases involving fiduciary digital access or stolen credentials.
sections.BNS_316_punish: Imprisonment up to 3 years and/or fine.
sections.BNS_351_desc: Covers threats to cause harm to a person, their reputation, or property with intent to cause alarm. Applies to online harassment and cyberstalking.
sections.BNS_351_punish: Imprisonment up to 2 years and/or fine.
sections.BNS_77_desc: Covers watching or capturing images of a woman engaged in a private act, without her consent, in circumstances where she would expect privacy.
sections.BNS_77_punish: First conviction: 1–3 years. Subsequent: 3–7 years. Plus fine.
sections.PMLA_3_desc: Applies when a person knowingly deals with proceeds of crime — including through cryptocurrency wallets with suspicious transaction volumes or mixing patterns.
sections.PMLA_3_punish: Rigorous imprisonment of 3–7 years (up to 10 years for narcotics) and fine.
sections.PMLA_4_desc: Prescribes the punishment for the offence of money laundering defined under Section 3. Triggered by significant cryptocurrency flows.
sections.PMLA_4_punish: Rigorous imprisonment of 3–7 years and fine which may extend to ₹5 Lakhs.
